content: 在朗讀數字任務中，每行之間必須暫停，以便後續進行語音分割。
evidence: you have to be sure to pause between each line, since we're going to be segmenting it and then doing it that way.

content: 在不錄製會議時，將所有電線捲起並收好，以防止人員絆倒。
evidence: when we're not using it to record a meeting we'll coil them all up and put them under so that people will not be tripping over them

content: 透過輕敲 PDA 和 PZM 麥克風來識別它們，並建議按順序記錄。
evidence: Um, can you do taps on the P_D_As? P_Z_Ms? And you have to actually check what the nu- Let's list them in order.

content: 錄音系統已內建降採樣功能，現在只錄製 16 kHz 的數據。
evidence: We've got built-in downsampling now. And so it's only recording sixteen kilohertz data

content: 系統不再錄製空閒頻道，並已刪除之前錄製但未使用的數據。
evidence: We're not recording the empty channels. I threw the ones out, that we already recorded but we didn't record.

content: 考慮將現有的數據處理方法轉換為更標準的格式，例如STM或XML文件。
evidence: we might wanna change it over to something a little more standard. You know, S_T_M files, or X_M_L, or something.

content: 發現重複啟動和停止錄音設備會導致系統崩潰，因此決定停止這種操作。
evidence: I think starting it and then stopping it and starting it again causes it to crash. So, I won't do that anymore.

content: 決定透過收集數位表格來記錄發言者位置，而非每次都要求發言者報上姓名，以簡化流程。
evidence: I'm gonna collect the digit forms and write it down.

content: 建議改變會議議程，優先討論研究相關事項，將瑣碎事務延後或透過電子郵件處理，以確保研究討論時間充足。
evidence: I'm suggesting we turn it around and - and uh sort of we have - anybody has some mundane points that we could send an email later, uh hold them for a bit, and let's talk about the - the research-y kind of things.

content: 建議將數字錄音（digit recordings）安排在會議結束時進行。
evidence: the new procedural change that just got suggested, which I think is a good idea is that um, we do the digit recordings at the end.

content: 傾向於收集更多已知類型的常規會議數據，而非一次性、多樣化的會議，因為後者難以處理和進行高階分析（如會議摘要）。
evidence: I'd rather try to get more regular meetings of types that we know about, and hear , then sort of a mish-mosh of a bunch of one - one-time - One offs? Yeah, just because it would be very hard to process the data in all senses, both to get the, um - to figure out what type of meeting it is and to do any kind of higher level work on it, like well, I was talking to Morgan about things like summarization, or what's this meeting about.

content: 數據採集策略應側重於收集同一團隊的不同會議，且這些會議應有不同的摘要內容；同時，不應只依賴單一團隊，而應包含三到四種不同類型的團隊。
evidence: rather we should have different meetings by the same group but hopefully that have different summaries. And then we need a couple that - of - We don't wanna just have one group because that might be specific to that particular group, but three or four different kinds.

content: 建議透過聯繫教授和領導專案的博士生，邀請他們將會議安排在實驗室進行，作為招募參與者的方式。
evidence: I was thinking more in terms of talking to professors uh, and - and - and uh, senior uh, uh, d- and uh, doctoral students who are leading projects and offering to them that they have their - hold their meeting down here.

content: 開發了一個腳本，用於將語音資料分割成每分鐘的片段，並分析其中涉及兩位、三位或更多說話者的重疊次數。
evidence: I wrote a script which divides things into individual minutes... What you can see is the number of overlaps and then to the right, whether they involve two speakers, three speakers, or more than three speakers.

content: 考慮將數據匿名化，以符合人類受試者研究倫理。
evidence: This is actually - when Jane sent this email first, is what caused me to start thinking about anonymizing the data.

content: 建議建立一個單一的說話者資訊表格，只需填寫一次，之後在數字語音表格上只需填寫姓名即可引用。
evidence: it would be nice to have a single speaker form that you fill out once. And then, on the digits form you just have to put your name down and you can look it up from the speaker form.

content: 說話者表格的初步設計包含姓名、性別、電子郵件或其他聯絡資訊，以便區分同名者並提供獨立於同意書的聯絡方式。
evidence: So the top of it is uh, Name, Sex Email or Other Contact Information. And I put the contact information just in case we have people with the same name, so that you can distinguish them, and then also just to have a separate contact from the consent form.

content: 說話者表格的教育程度類別初步設定為：大學生、研究生、博士後、教授，以及一個可填寫的「其他」選項。
evidence: five things that you can circle, Undergrad, Grad, Post-doc, Professor, and then Other

content: 討論了使用獨立的DTD（文件類型定義）來處理會議特定的相關資訊，以捕捉關係型數據。
evidence: the separate D_T_ Ds would handle maybe, s- specific - meeting-specific things that might be relevant. ... the Data Type Definition - the Document Type Definition p- part that it's - can s- be used for relational things

content: 建議將「教授」類別修改為「博士後研究員」或類似的描述，以更好地涵蓋非教授職位的博士學位持有者。
evidence: How about Post-P_H_D researcher or something

content: 語音/非語音預分割系統從單一高斯模型改為多混合高斯模型，以更好地處理語音和非語音部分。
evidence: It was a system which used only one Gaussian for silence and one Gaussian for speech. And now I added, uh, multi-mixture possibility for - for speech and nonspeech.

content: 為了處理對話中音量不同的說話者，系統增加了針對大聲和安靜說話者的獨立高斯混合模型。
evidence: I did two mixtures, one for the loud speakers and one for the quiet speakers.

content: 調整了語音和靜音部分的最小長度參數，以控制插入的靜音部分數量。
evidence: You can specify the minimum length of speech or - and silence portions which you want. And so I did some - some modifications in those parameters, basically changing the minimum - minimum length for s- for silence to have, er- to have, um - yeah - to have more or less, uh, silence portions in- inserted.
